comparisons.reason: Both read only the argument column (OP body, current text) and return a binary 1 if the OP recounts their own personal experience, else 0. Both exclude abstract, hypothetical, third-party and unadopted quoted content, and both exclude generic opinions. Both ignore title and comments. Wording differs: 'anecdote or first-person experiential narrative' versus 'explicit narrative of personal experience'. This is a harmless paraphrase. Null handling differs slightly: one says 'missing or empty/malformed' and the other says 'missing or malformed/unreadable'. This is not a material difference.
